openings.claim: Cork-padded bolted strips may retain either plate with screw-loaded friction through existing slots, replacing magnetic dependence and permitting gloved screwdriver release; drill strips only.
openings.discriminator: Against magnets, equal clamp settings should reduce substitution sensitivity. Spare displacement >1 mm or service >60 seconds defeats D1.
openings.probe: Check M4 slot fit, support, clearance and screwdriver access; fabricate only if compliant. Measure original/spare displacement over twenty strokes and time removal/return without touching the marked edge; final spare service uses gloves.
openings.uncertainty: Geometry, strip stiffness/preload and stroke loads are unknown; sufficient stiffness/preload and compliant mounting are assumed.

openings.claim: A bounded pocket may retain without primarily relying on pad friction: plier-bend supplied strips into opposing unmarked-region stops, mount through existing slots; a drilled strip pivots on a supplied bolt and overlaps an unmarked face against lift.
openings.discriminator: Under comparable safe pulls, pocket movement should arrest at measured gap while D1 may progressively slip; neither observed. Magnetic differences should matter little. Gap >1 mm, keeper lift or slow gloved access defeats D2.
openings.probe: Before bending, verify four strips/six bolts suffice for opposing stops, lift restraint and accessible opening outside clearance/working edge. If possible reuse stock for configuration two; mark references, compare displacement/service timing against D1. Optional scale pulls stop at 10 N; record arrested movement versus progressive slip without stroke-load equivalence.
openings.uncertainty: Assumes slot geometry supports pocket, strips bend and keeper access suits gloves.

lineage.reason: Friction, magnetic comparator, conditional fabrication, defeat conditions and uncertainty preserved.
Pocket/keeper, friction rival, unobserved predictions, pull limit and assumptions preserved.

decision: Probe only. No plate/carriage drilling, cutting, heating or gluing; expose marked 30 mm edge; no added part enters stroke clearance; carriage stays on rails. Require <=1 mm after twenty strokes and <=60-second edge-untouched removal/return. Share 80 fabrication/20 observation minutes; maximum two configurations, three twenty-stroke runs and three service checks each. Final runs use spare, removal thick gloves. Unknown stroke duration, geometry and ruler resolution may prevent informative completion; caps do not establish feasibility.
